meta.note: Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's, as the official list publishes them. Every guide below is written for this entry and names its sources; a source is cited, never copied.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Nothing extra to perform: this is the last thing on the list and it arrives on its own once the other 54 are on the account. No online or DLC trophy exists at launch and free roam stays open after the credits, so one save file can carry the whole platinum. The real cost is the 100% checklist plus eight stranger strands, which guides put near 200 hours. Keep the run cheat-free, because a cheat switches off trophies and saving for that session.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum pops last.
Keep one clean save: cheats disable trophies and saving.
Leave the 100% checklist and the stranger strands for after the credits.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Vice Got a Price! trophy page
GTA Snaps — Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission, where Jason walks into the Kingfishers' swamp camp to pull Donnie out, is all it asks. It sits on the main path in Chapter 1, so it cannot be skipped and needs no detour. The camp you clear is also one of that gang's illegal operations, which saves a trip when you later chase Pest Control.
steps: Play Gone Fishing, the first mission of Chapter 1.
Nothing to collect or trigger: it lands on the mission-complete screen.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Just Like Paradise trophy page
KeenGamer — All 9 gangs and the Pest Control trophy

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapter 1 carries 22 main missions and the trophy lands as the chapter closes and Chapter 2 opens, so guides date the pop to the first Chapter 2 mission rather than to the last Chapter 1 one. Only story missions count; the Chapter 1 extras that do close (the balcony meditation and Shirley's two errands) are not part of this trophy. Take the balcony meditation anyway, because it feeds a different, time-limited one.
steps: Finish all 22 Chapter 1 main missions.
Before the chapter ends, do the balcony meditation at Jason's house.
Shirley's two errands shut when Tourist Trap starts; they are not needed here.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Paradise Lost trophy page
GTA Culture — 91 story missions in 5 chapters

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: The censored name is the chapter title itself. Chapter 2 is the shortest of the five at 11 main missions, and the trophy pops as Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City, so there is nothing to chase beyond the story. This is also the chapter that hands you the partner call after Coffee Break, the Moses garage jobs and Bret's hunting strand, all of which other trophies depend on.
steps: Finish the 11 Chapter 2 main missions.
Note the unlocks along the way: partner call, garage jobs, Bret's texts.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — T**s Ass Drug Money trophy page
GTA Culture — mission list by chapter

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 is the biggest block in the game at 26 main missions, and the trophy arrives a mission or two into Chapter 4, which guides tie to Another Life. It is purely story-gated, so play the chapter out. Chapter 3 is also where the useful economy unlocks land: the Dye Pack Jammer after Credit Check, jewelry stores after Yasmani's jobs, and the Key Cloner from Randy's car job.
steps: Finish all 26 Chapter 3 main missions.
Watch for the mid-chapter unlocks: bank jobs, jewelry, Key Cloner.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Vice City, Baby! trophy page
GTABase — 100% completion checklist

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Awarded when Chapter 4's last main mission finishes; guides name Starting From Zero as the trigger. The chapter runs 25 missions and holds three of the named-mission trophies, so most of the work is simply playing through. Keep a manual save at the start and end of the chapter: missions cannot be replayed, and the save is your only way back to a branch or a missed beat.
steps: Finish the 25 Chapter 4 main missions, ending with Starting From Zero.
Save by hand at the chapter's start and end.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Top Of The World, Ma trophy page
GTA Snaps — roadmap and save advice

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The finale of Chapter 5, which guides title The End of the Road, and one of only two golds in the list. It is unmissable and it does not close the game: free roam, the side strands and the 100% checklist all stay open afterwards, which is why the platinum needs only one playthrough. Save before the finale if you want to see another ending.
steps: Play the seven Chapter 5 missions through to the finale.
Keep a manual save before the last mission for the other endings.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — You Gotta Know When to Get Off
GTA6 Pocket — what stays open after the story

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A single Chapter 2 story mission, Breakfast Run, and the trophy comes with it. There is no optional condition and no collectible involved, so you cannot lose it by playing badly. It is one of six named-mission story trophies, and all of them sit on the critical path.
steps: Complete Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.
Nothing else is required.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Trust trophy page
GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist closes Chapter 3 and pays about $120,000. It opens once Hidden Charges and the rest of the chapter's main missions are done. Two habits make it smoother: the crates you stash in Company Property become the charges used in Hidden Charges, and blowing all three cell towers buys roughly eleven minutes to reach the bank. Threaten staff instead of killing them if you want the cleaner rating.
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 main missions up to Hidden Charges.
Blow all three cell towers for the full time window.
Threaten rather than kill to keep the professional rating.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Break the Bank trophy page
PowerPyx — Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is the Chapter 4 mission where Jason and Lucia go after the people holding Rafa, and the trophy pops inside it. It cannot be missed. The one thing worth doing right after is Lucia's optional job This is a Free Call From, which shows an hourglass on the map and fails if you leave it; it carries no trophy but it is easy to lose.
steps: Play Child's Play in Chapter 4.
Start Lucia's hourglass job This is a Free Call From as soon as it appears.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Family Matters trophy page
GTA6 Pocket — missables and hourglass missions

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is the Chapter 4 mission where the Real Dimez play a launch party at VYB, and the trophy comes with the mission. Guides place it directly before VCIA Takedown, which makes it a natural place for a manual save before the airport heist. Nothing optional is counted, so a straight playthrough is enough.
steps: Complete Headliners in Chapter 4.
Save afterwards, before starting the VCIA setup chain.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — DWNFALL trophy page
PowerPyx — mission order in the roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is the airport heist in Chapter 4 and it comes after a long setup chain, which guides count at more than a dozen preparatory steps from Making Gainz to Heist Plans in Place. Finish every setup before starting the heist and keep a manual save from just before it. Clearing it also opens the optional That's Where The Money Is, which is what unlocks the large bank vaults for Maximum Withdrawal.
steps: Complete every VCIA setup step before starting the heist.
Save by hand before the heist itself.
Afterwards start That's Where The Money Is to unlock vaults.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Hi-Jacked trophy page
GTABase — 100% checklist, vaults and bank jobs

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 story mission and the trophy lands with it. Chapter 5 is the shortest chapter, seven missions, and this is one of the two trophies inside it. There is no optional requirement, so simply play the chapter; the finale is the other trophy in it.
steps: Complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
Nothing optional is counted.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Snow Storm trophy page
GTA Culture — 5 chapters, 91 missions

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The checklist lives under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and only becomes visible after the credits, though everything done earlier already counts. It asks for less than the name suggests: the story is 50%, and many lines accept partial work. Plan around the full lines first, because they are the ones that hurt: all bank and gang robberies, all 42 shooting-range golds, all 42 drone trials and all 15 of Bret's target decks. Everything is still open after the story, so nothing here is missable.
steps: Finish the story first; the checklist only shows after the credits.
Clear the all-or-nothing lines: robberies, 42 range golds, 42 drone trials, 15 target decks.
Use the partial lines as filler: 300 of 397 stunts, 15 of 18 card sets, 70 of 80 challenges.

sources.name: GTABase — 100% completion guide and checklist
GTA Snaps — roadmap, weights and time

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: The game holds 397 stunts in four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge runs, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Any 250 count, so the under-bridge runs are the cheapest way to bulk up the number. Track them by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and remember the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past the trophy if you are chasing the gold.
steps: Farm under-the-bridge runs first; there are 202 of them.
Mix in stunt jumps near your other errands.
Stop at 250 for the trophy, or push to 300 for the checklist.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Cunning Stunts trophy page
GTABase — 100% checklist, stunt totals

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Nine activity types, one attempt each: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, a basketball hoop, a video game, a race win (a race challenge or drone race counts) and a stunt. Attempting is enough for most of them, so the trophy is a checklist of first visits rather than a grind. Most happen naturally while you work the map; check what is left under Progress, Activities, after the story.
steps: Try one of each: fishing, hunting, golf, range, pool, hoop, video game, race, stunt.
Check Progress, Activities for any type still at zero.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Master of None trophy page
Push Square — Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Two ranges hold the 42 golds: Griffin Shooting Range in Vice City, whose six courses end on Beginner through Master and supply 18, and Rodgers Ranch near Port Gellhorn, six score-based courses supplying 24. Buy the $5 waiver pass from the clerk inside each shop to unlock the challenges, then use your own gun or rent one for $10 a run. Griffin's courses are timed, so play Lucia for the on-foot ones and take the bullseye bonus only when it is on your route; Rodgers Ranch rewards a stacked multiplier, so land a body shot or two before the head.
steps: Buy the $5 waiver pass at Griffin and at Rodgers Ranch.
Griffin: play as Lucia, run the courses, ignore far-off bullseyes.
Rodgers Ranch: build the multiplier with body shots, then finish with heads.

sources.name: GTA Culture — both ranges, all 42 golds
GTABase — 100% checklist, 18 + 24 golds

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Fourteen stations, three trials each, 42 races in all, and the trophy needs one win at every station rather than every race. The first two trials at a station must be finished inside par time before the third unlocks, and the third only has to be completed. Stations appear as blue icons within about a hundred metres, or filter Map, Activities, Top Fun Drones. A taxi reaches every station except Dalton Island, which needs a boat or an aircraft.
steps: Filter Map, Activities, Top Fun Drones to find all 14 stations.
Win one race per station; beat par on the first two trials to open the third.
Take a boat or plane for Dalton Island.

sources.name: Tech4Gamers — 14 stations and 42 time trials
GTABase — 100% checklist, drone trials

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Twenty different races, not twenty wins: repeating a favourite circuit adds nothing, so work through the blue race icons that appear within about a hundred metres of you. The map has 40 unique races, which leaves room to skip the ones you dislike, and the checklist asks for 30 wins if you are going for 100%. Most race locations hire cars out, which is easier than building one.
steps: Win 20 distinct races from the map's blue icons.
Skip repeats: the same race twice counts once.
Hire a car at the location rather than using your own.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Earn Cash, Not Kudos trophy page
GTA Culture — every race and activity

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal hands out fishing challenges from Chapter 1 onward; his first job is Catch A Bigger Fish and the trophy comes when you beat his mark, reported as a parrotfish of about two kilos. Fish the marked water until one that size takes the hook, then land it. You need a boat with a rod, and plenty sit in the area to borrow if you have none. The strand stays open after the story.
steps: Wait for Cal's text after the Chapter 1 mission where you meet him.
Fish the marked spot until a parrotfish above his mark bites.
Borrow a boat with a rod if you have not bought one.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Baited My Tackle trophy page
Push Square — fishing challenge walkthrough

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish every level of any one of the four playable games. Three sit on the console at home and Bang For Your Buck lives on arcade cabinets around the map; the home TV is out of action for part of Chapter 2 and comes back in Chapter 3, so an arcade machine is the dependable route. The checklist only asks you to start all four, so a single completed game covers both.
steps: Pick one game and clear every level.
Use an arcade cabinet if the home console is unavailable.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Stick Fiddler trophy page
GTABase — 100% checklist, video games

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's five-part Cellerica strand opens on the map in Chapter 3 and only Lucia can run it, so switch characters if the marker refuses to appear for Jason. Work through the delivery jobs, the initiation fee and the campus initiation, then the warehouse cleanup, and the trophy lands at the end of the last job, Puff Puff Pass. The strand survives the credits, but the character lock is the usual reason players think it is broken.
steps: Play as Lucia and start Andy's Cellerica jobs in Chapter 3.
Finish all five, ending with Puff Puff Pass.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Road to Rehabilitation trophy page
GTABase — Strangers & Freaks mission list

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton appears after the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams and marks shipwreck treasures with purple chests: dive, sweep the seabed with the metal detector, dig and hand the haul over. Clear all seven sets to finish his strand. He goes quiet between the end of Chapter 1 and the middle of the story, and calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 brings him back sooner; the sets themselves stay open after the credits.
steps: Meet Kenton after Island Dreams and take the seven treasure sets.
Dive each wreck, dig with the metal detector, return the loot.
In Chapter 2, phone Brian as Jason to speed his return.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — This Was No Boat Accident
GTA6 Pocket — Kenton's treasure timing

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's crew meets you at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County once a Chapter 2 main mission has passed, and his strand is five jobs: a mud race, a car pulled out of the police impound, then the crew's biggest job. Finish all five and the trophy comes with the last. Guides still mark the exact trigger as unconfirmed, so if nothing shows, keep playing main missions and check the mudclub again.
steps: After a Chapter 2 main mission, visit the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Run Billy's five jobs to the crew's final heist.

sources.name: GTA Culture — The Lone Rider trophy guide
GTABase — Strangers & Freaks mission list

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight whole strands, not eight missions: a strand only counts once its last job is done. The ones guides confirm as counting include Kirk's Skunk Ape hunt, Kyle's farm work, Yago's races and Pilot Pete's airdrops, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie are tracked elsewhere and do not add to the count. Watch Yago: his Race Against Yago job runs on an hourglass and starting it late can cost you the strand.
steps: Finish eight complete strands: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed counters.
Start any hourglass job the moment it appears, especially Race Against Yago.
Ignore Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie for this count.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Strangers & Freaks trophy page
Bloxodes — missable trophies and missions

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy starts with the Chapter 3 car theft that also hands you the Key Cloner, then opens his Wish List: sixteen named cars to steal and drop at his garage in western Vice City, marked with an RK icon. Deliver them in good condition and the strand closes with the trophy. The same deliveries pay well, so this doubles as the fastest route to the fencing total the checklist wants.
steps: Complete Randy's Chapter 3 car job for the Key Cloner.
Steal the 16 Wish List cars and deliver each to his garage.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Supply & Demand trophy page
GTABase — 100% checklist, vehicle fencing

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand is Jason's, and it opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. He wants the synthetic drug labs around Vice City shut down, a set number of raids, and then the follow-up job that gives the trophy its name. Tyrone also pays the best rate for narcotics, so robbing labs for him and selling the product in La Perle covers two grinds at once.
steps: Play as Jason and start Tyrone's jobs after Here, Kitty Kitty.
Destroy the required synthetic labs, then finish Spin On This.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Spin On This! trophy page
KeenGamer — fences and selling narcotics

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableReason: The first meditation is Jason's balcony at his Key Lento house, and it only exists during Chapter 1. Lucia offers it in the morning after Down to Earth; follow her out, talk to her and accept. Once Chapter 1 ends the prompt is gone for good, so it is the one trophy that can be lost outright.
trophies.guide: Eighteen meditations across ten spots, because most spots count once for each character, and the last one at the top of Mount Kalaga only appears after the rest are done. Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations, and sit through the closing animation or the spot does not register.
steps: Take Lucia's balcony offer at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — the only missable one.
Meditate at each of the ten spots with both characters where allowed.
Finish with the Mount Kalaga spot, which unlocks after the other 17.

sources.name: GTA Vibes — all 18 meditations at 10 spots
GTA6 Pocket — the Chapter 1 balcony cutoff

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel texts Jason after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break and sets up his hunting business in Lummox County; his first job hands over the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle, which you can collect from any Ammu-Nation locker. Work the purple target areas and bring back the animals he names until a unique one falls. Guides have not pinned down which deck triggers it, and the checklist wants all fifteen anyway, so keep going.
steps: After Coffee Break, answer Bret's text as Jason in Lummox County.
Collect the Killtelligence SM-69 from an Ammu-Nation locker.
Clear target decks until the unique animal hunt completes.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Fair Game trophy page
GTABase — 100% checklist, Bret's target decks

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: There are 18 sets and 480 cards in all, and only three complete sets are needed here. A set has to be finished to count, so spreading pickups across many sets gets you nothing. Cards can be sold at pawn shops without losing progress, which frees the cash for other trophies. The checklist wants 15 complete sets, so the three you finish now are the start of a longer sweep rather than a detour.
steps: Pick three sets and finish them completely.
Track progress under Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards.
Sell duplicates at pawn shops; selling does not reset the set.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Don't Touch My Deck trophy page
Nerd Snack — all 18 sets and 480 cards

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK is the scanning app on the phone: hold up on the d-pad, and when a scannable object is close the pad buzzes and a notice appears, then hold the scan and centre the starburst icon. The tracked sets are landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and the No Flusher pavement tags, and there are more than a hundred in total, so skip the awkward ones. Street art and mural scans are tracked separately and do not add to this count.
steps: Walk the city on foot; the pad buzzes when a scan is in range.
Scan any 100 from landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags.
Skip street art and murals: they count elsewhere.

sources.name: GTA Culture — WAiNK types and the 100 count
GTAVIMaps — You WAiNKer! trophy page

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Eighty challenges in eight categories of ten, all live from the start, and fifty of them are enough. They are skill tests rather than story content, so normal play finishes a good share on its own; check Progress, Challenges to see what is left. Leave this for the end of the run and pick the quick ones, since the checklist only wants seventy and you can skip the ten slowest outright.
steps: Check Progress, Challenges and finish the easy ones first.
Stop at 50 for the trophy; go to 70 only for the checklist.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — One Last Thing trophy page
GTABase — 100% checklist, challenges

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Call your partner along after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, then build a four-star wanted level with them in the car and shake it off, clearing the red search zone as well. Many players get it during the Chapter 4 optional job That's Where The Money Is, which starts at four stars anyway. A reliable escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County. Failing only costs a reload, so there is nothing permanent at stake.
steps: Call your partner with the hold-right-and-triangle prompt.
Reach four stars, then break line of sight and leave the red zone.
Use the Ambrosia train tunnel in Kelly County to vanish.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Hot Together trophy page
Bloxodes — failed attempts are not permanent

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Three robberies in a row with your partner in tow, and the flashing wanted level must never drop between them: if it clears, the chain resets. The trophy arrives about half a minute after you leave the third shop, so keep moving. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3, are the tightest cluster. Bring armour, healing and something for the safes.
steps: Bring your partner and hit three shops without letting the wanted level clear.
Use the north Vice City jewelry cluster after Yasmani's jobs.
Keep driving after the third shop until the trophy pops.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Retail Therapy trophy page
The GTA 6 Guide — requirements and notes

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: A vehicle is discovered when you get inside it or scan it with WAiNK, and the app works from Chapter 1. Scanning is the better habit: the checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, and each region has its own traffic, from supercars around the Ocean Beach hotels to work trucks in Port Gellhorn. Boats and aircraft count, while the 280 standout vehicles parked at fixed spots do not.
steps: Scan every new vehicle you pass with the WAiNK app.
Drive through each region for its local traffic, boats and aircraft.
Check Progress, Vehicles to see the gap to 200.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Whip It Good trophy page
GTABase — 100% checklist, vehicle scans

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is L3 plus R3 while aiming, and all five kills have to land inside one activation. Gang members at an illegal operation are the best targets; police, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count. Fill the Focus bar first by eating, drinking or showering at home, carry an assault rifle and armour, and start the burst when the room is already full of enemies rather than hunting for the fifth.
steps: Top up Focus at home before you travel.
Raid a gang operation and activate Combat Focus with five targets in view.
Keep firing until the fifth drops before the meter empties.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Gunslinger trophy page
PowerPyx — Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Vice City International Airport has airliners parked at the boarding bridges, and any of them will do: board one, get it airborne and put about a kilometre between yourself and the airport. The plane at gates E3 and E4 is the easiest to reach from the airfield side, where the fencing is thinner. Expect a wanted level on the way up; the trophy only cares that you left without a slot.
steps: Enter VCIA from the airfield side and take the airliner at gates E3 or E4.
Take off and fly roughly a kilometre clear of the airport.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Catch Me If You Can trophy page
The GTA 6 Guide — hidden trophy notes

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The Rhino is parked at Mile Zero Air Station, the military island off south-west Mariana County. Get onto the base, take the tank and fire on enemies until the counter is satisfied; guides list the Rhino among the vehicles stationed there. The base is a restricted area, so the approach is the hard part and the shooting is not. Do it after the story, when you are not protecting a mission save.
steps: Reach Mile Zero Air Station and steal the Rhino tank.
Fire on enemies until the trophy unlocks.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Challenging Tank trophy page
The GTA 6 Guide — Rhino at Mile Zero Air Station

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: A silent jewelry robbery: pick the back door with the Snap Gun, read the safe code written in the back room, open the safe and leave without a single detection. Jewelry stores open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3, and Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is the usual recommendation for a clean run. If the alarm or a witness triggers, the attempt is spent, so reload and try again rather than pushing on.
steps: After Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, pick a store such as Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds.
Snap Gun the back door, find the safe code, empty the safe unseen.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Sneakthief trophy page
GTABase — 100% checklist, smash and grabs

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: The large bank vaults only become robbable after the Chapter 4 optional job That's Where The Money Is, which teaches the routine: tail a security van until it stops, wait for the cash to go inside, then break in while the door is open. Crack five of the eight and escape each time. Your partner can carry bags when yours fill up, and Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000 once his earlier jobs are done. The checklist wants all eight.
steps: Complete That's Where The Money Is to unlock vault robberies.
Follow a security van, wait for the drop, hit the open vault.
Escape at four stars and repeat at five different banks.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Maximum Withdrawal trophy page
GTABase — vaults and the security-van routine

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Stop an armoured truck, take what is inside and get clear of the police. The Chapter 4 optional job That's Where The Money Is introduces the security-van routine and is the cleanest place to do it, and guides note that a large vault robbery counts as well. One successful truck is enough, so a single attempt during the vault grind covers it without a separate trip.
steps: Start That's Where The Money Is in Chapter 4.
Rob the armoured truck or a large vault and escape the pursuit.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — A Classic Blitz Play trophy page
GTABase — 100% checklist, bank jobs

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: This is map fog rather than a list: drive or fly into every region of Leonida until the map stops hiding ground. The counties are large and the islands are the usual gap, so take an aircraft and sweep the edges, then run the coast roads at low level. Nothing on the map is locked after the story, so it can wait until the end, when the collectible sweeps already have you crossing most of the state.
steps: Sweep every county by road and by air until the fog clears.
Check the islands and the far edges last; they are the common misses.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — The Goodtime State trophy page
GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: One operation from each of the nine gangs: the Kingfishers in the Grassrivers, Kolts & Associates in Port Gellhorn, M7, La Polilla Negra at Watson Bay, Final Chapter MC in Ambrosia, San4San in La Perle, PTT Youngin$, the Guardia Brothers and the catch-all Other Criminals. An operation only counts when every key valuable is looted, safe included, so read the icon preview before you go in. Track it under Progress, Gangs; the checklist wants all 39 operations.
steps: Read each operation's icon preview for its key valuables and security level.
Clear the guards quietly, crack the safe, loot every valuable.
Check Progress, Gangs for the one gang still at zero.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The best lead is the rooftop bar of the Ocean View hotel on Ocean Beach: take the roof access past the pool and order an apple martini, reported at about $10. That comes from a player report rather than the big guides, which still list the trigger as unknown, so treat the exact drink as a guess with a good address attached. The bar itself is on PowerPyx's list, so the location is the reliable part.
steps: Go to the Ocean View hotel on Ocean Beach and take the roof access past the pool.
Order a cocktail at the rooftop bar and drink it there.

PowerPyx — bar list and trophy roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The target is the blue Banshee on the showroom floor in southern Vice City. You need the Key Cloner, which comes from Randy's Chapter 3 car job, to start it; then drive straight out through the window. Only that Banshee counts, and the trophy pops a few seconds later, once you are a little way down the street, so keep rolling instead of stopping in the broken glass.
steps: Get the Key Cloner from Randy's Chapter 3 job.
Clone the blue Banshee in the southern Vice City showroom and drive it through the window.
Keep driving down the street until the trophy appears.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Capital Offense trophy page
GTA Vibes — stealing the Banshee for Capital Offense

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: This is the Chapter 2 optional robbery Hit Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, not a bowling minigame. Three valuables have to leave with you: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball shotgun on the north-east table and whatever is in the safe. Bring sticky bombs for the safe, and escape the police to close it out. The three items can be collected across more than one visit, so a botched run is not fatal.
steps: Start Hit Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn during Chapter 2.
Take the watch, the shotgun and the safe contents, then escape.

sources.name: GTAVIMaps — Let's Go Bowling trophy page
PowerPyx — Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Both Jason and Lucia have to reach maximum Strength. The partner call opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, so bring one along and work out at the fitness clubs until both bars are full; the call prompt is hold right plus triangle. Strength is also what makes the melee and Combat Focus trophies easier, so it is worth doing before the combat cleanup rather than after.
steps: Unlock the partner call after Coffee Break.
Take each character to a fitness club and max the Strength bar.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The count is 500 actions that move your Criminal Profile, and ordinary play gets most of the way there. If you are short at the end, causing chaos speeds it up: running people over and provoking police both register. The side effect is worth knowing, since at Psycho and Irredeemable the police open fire faster, which makes the stealth and escape trophies harder. Finish those first if you are close to the threshold.
steps: Play normally; the counter moves with most crimes and choices.
If short, cause mayhem, but leave stealth trophies for before Psycho.

PowerPyx — Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Nobody has confirmed this one. The strongest lead ties it to the payday loan store from the prologue, and those stores only become robbery targets after Credit Check in Chapter 3, so robbing one is the sensible test. If it does not fire, work through the payday loan chain and try a second store; guides treat it as a cleanup item rather than something to plan a run around.
steps: After Credit Check, rob a payday loan store.
If it does not unlock, try another store in the chain.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The UFO shows up in Kelly County, east of Port Gellhorn, near the Starlet Motel, and only after 2:00 AM in-game time from Chapter 2 onward. Look for a parked car with its lights flashing and doors open, then follow the scattered clothes and the static into the trees. Walk into the light, help the person on the ground and answer them, then head back to the road; the encounter ends with you being taken instead, which is the point of the trophy.
steps: Drive to the Starlet Motel area of Kelly County after 2:00 AM.
Follow the flashing car, clothes and static to the light.
Help the person, then walk back toward the road.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description is the instruction: knock someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. PowerPyx's reading is a kick from a motorcycle, which fits the wording and is easy to arrange in traffic. Ride alongside a pedestrian or a gang member, time the melee so the hit lands, and expect the wanted level to follow. It is a five-second job once you are on a bike.
steps: Get on a motorcycle and ride beside a target.
Land the melee kick while moving to bowl them over.

PowerPyx — Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills come out of banks and payday loan stores, and they can only be cleaned once you hold the Dye Pack Jammer from Credit Check in Chapter 3. Hand a running total of $250,000 to fences; Yasmani pays the best rate, and the total carries across every robbery. A single large bank vault can hold more than $200,000, so two good vaults plus a payday store usually finish it.
steps: Get the Dye Pack Jammer from Credit Check in Chapter 3.
Rob banks and payday loan stores for marked bills.
Fence $250,000 in total, preferably with Yasmani.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: A running total of $100,000 spent in shops, and it does not have to happen in one place: gun stores, mod shops, clothing, tattoo studios and salons all count. Weapons, car modifications and tattoos burn money fastest, so buy the expensive options rather than a hundred cheap ones. Filter the map by Style to see the shops, and do it after the story when the bank balance is healthy.
steps: Spend across gun stores, mod shops, clothing, tattoos and salons.
Buy the costly items: weapons, mods, ink.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Eight garages are for sale through the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks with the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Prices run from about $4,000 to $40,000 and the set costs roughly $160,000 in total, so this is a late-run purchase rather than an early one. The other seven garages in the game come free with the story or with edition bonuses and do not count toward the eight.
steps: Unlock the Vice City Real Estate app in Chapter 2.
Buy all eight purchasable garages, about $160,000 in total.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 2 mission Moses, take stolen cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray and then Register, and the car joins Scooter Bros for delivery later. Ten registrations are needed, and each one takes a garage slot, so buy the cheap garages first or you will be turned away. From Chapter 3, cars with standard trackers can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray instead.
steps: Unlock Moses' garage in Chapter 2 and free up parking space.
Bring ten cars in, Respray then Register each one.
From Chapter 3, use any Pay 'n' Spray for tracked cars.
